lineItems.description: Attendance Management System - Device Setup & Configuration
lineItems.details: Complete setup and configuration of biometric/RFID attendance devices for 20 users. Includes device provisioning, network integration, employee enrollment, and initial system training.

Annual subscription to FlowZa Time cloud attendance platform for 20 users. Includes real-time attendance tracking, automated reporting, leave management, mobile app access, and 24/7 technical support.

Annual subscription to FlowZa Time cloud attendance platform for 20 users (Year 2). Includes real-time attendance tracking, automated reporting, leave management, mobile app access, and 24/7 technical support.

installments.details: Device setup (300 OMR) + Year 1 subscription (80 OMR)
Annual renewal on the same date as Year 1

notes.terms: This quotation is valid for 30 days from the date above. Prices do not include VAT where applicable.
notes.technicalRequirements: Internet connectivity (minimum 2 Mbps), secure network for device integration
notes.implementation: Typical implementation and go-live within 2-3 weeks of contract signing
notes.additionalServices: Additional users beyond 20 can be added at 4 OMR per user per year. Custom device integrations available upon request.
